review_candidates.description: About The Opportunity Job Type: Permanent Application Deadline: 31 December 2026 Job Description Title Research Analyst Department Research Location Tokyo, Japan Reports To Director of Research Level Grade 7/8 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our [insert name of team/ business area] team and feel like you’re part of something bigger. About Your Team Fidelity International has an Asia Pacific regional research team based in Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia, Korea, Japan and India. The team provides investment recommendations to fund managers both locally and worldwide. About Your Role Equity Research Associates/Analysts are organised into seven broad industry groupings and cover the regions on a sector-by-sector basis. Their role is to carry out detailed research on each company (within their designated sector) from reviewing assets and cash flow to evaluating the management and assessing the environment in which the company is trading. We call this the “bottom-up” approach to stock picking. Our Research Analyst works as part of our regional research team in Asia Pacific, assuming analytical responsibility for sector coverage and providing investment recommendations to our Portfolio Managers both locally and worldwide. Although the position will be based in Tokyo, the role will be required to work closely with analysts/associates in other locations. About You Following are the qualifications required for this position: Excellent financial analytical skills Strong written and verbal communication capabilities Fluent spoken and written Japanese and English Highly motivated, able to think logically, critically & quickly Able to work both independently and as part of a Research/Investment team Avidly interested and have a passion for the stock market and has demonstrated this interest through either previous work or personal investment. Feel rewarded For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com. review_candidates.title: Regional Service Manager, Asia
review_candidates.company: A middle size global lab equipment company
review_candidates.location: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
review_candidates.description: Work as Individual Contributor CLIENT PROFILE Our client is a well-known global solution provider in laboratory technology, supporting R&D, Quality Control, and production. With Global Headquarter in Europe, their essential and innovative equipment primarily serves critical sectors, including chemical and pharmaceutical research, food & feed quality control, and environmental monitoring applications. The company has been in China, Japan, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and other countries in Asia. THE ROLE You will report to Global Head of Customer Service in Europe and be responsible for driving the performance, growth, and operational excellence of the service business across the region. The role connects local service teams with global strategy, ensuring alignment on processes, portfolio, and commercial priorities. The position focuses on improving service revenue, strengthening service profitability, and enhancing customer experience by enabling local markets and service teams through structure, tools, and best practices. Responsibilities Own and grow service revenue across Asia in partnership with General Managers and local service leaders. Identify regional and cluster-specific growth opportunities through market and portfolio analysis. Initiate and steer regional service commercial initiatives (up-selling, cross-selling, renewals). Coordinate regional service marketing activities aligned with global and local strategies. Establish and scale remote Regional Support Centers. Support the transition from legacy services to next-generation, value-added offerings. Define and evolve the regional distributor service portfolio, ensuring clear value propositions and execution readiness. Define meaningful KPIs and dashboards that enable fact-based decision-making. Support General Managers in understanding, benchmarking, and improving service P&L performance. Identify capability gaps and regional training needs across Asia. Design scalable support models (e.g. 2nd-level support, shared expertise hubs). Promote a customer-focused, performance-oriented service culture across the region. WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 8+ years’ experience in service, aftersales, or field operations in laboratory, scientific, technical instrumentation or related industry. Proven success growing and steering a service business in a matrix and multi-country environment. Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all levels without direct authority. Structured, analytical thinker with the ability to turn insight into pragmatic actions. Fluent in English and other additional Asian languages highly valued. Willingness to travel 30-50% across Asia.

review_candidates.description: CT Modulex is seeking an experienced and results-driven Finance Manager to lead corporate financial planning, budgeting, cash flow management, and fundraising activities, supporting our business operations and strategic technology projects. Key responsibilities include: Financial Planning & Budgeting: Develop and manage annual budgets (OPEX & CAPEX), financial forecasts, cash flow projections, and financial performance analysis. Fundraising & Capital Management: Develop funding strategies, secure financial resources, and coordinate with banks, investment funds, and financial institutions. R&D Project Financing: Prepare financial plans, project budgets, and funding proposals for science, technology, and innovation projects; coordinate with relevant government authorities on applicable funding mechanisms and financial regulations. Corporate Financial Coordination: Collaborate with the Group and affiliated companies to optimize capital allocation, intercompany funding arrangements, and financial resources. International Financial Partnerships: Establish and maintain relationships with international investors, financial institutions, and investment funds, particularly Australian partners. Financial Risk Management: Monitor liquidity, working capital, financial risks, and capital utilization; develop financial management reports to support executive decision-making. 🎓 QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Accounting, Banking, Economics, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in corporate finance , including at least 2 years in a managerial position . Strong expertise in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Budgeting, Cash Flow Management, and Fundraising . Proven ability to develop financial models, funding strategies, and investment feasibility analyses. Experience working with banks, investment funds, financial institutions, or multinational corporations is highly preferred. Knowledge of government-funded R&D projects, science and technology financing mechanisms, or public funding regulations is an advantage. Strong analytical, strategic planning, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Good command of English, with the ability to communicate and work effectively with international partners. Proactive, results-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment. 💼 WHAT WE OFFER Competitive and negotiable compensation package. Opportunity to work directly with executive management on strategic financial initiatives. Exposure to innovative technology, R&D, and high-impact business projects. Opportunities to collaborate with domestic and international financial partners. Career development opportunities toward Finance Director / Chief Financial Officer (CFO) positions. 📩 HOW TO APPLY Interested candidates are invited to send their updated CV to: 📧 nhut.nguyen.m@ctmodulex.com Email Subject: [Finance Manager] – Full Name Alternatively, feel free to contact us directly via LinkedIn for further information. Join CT Modulex and play a key role in shaping the financial future of our technology-driven business! #CTModulex #WeAreHiring #FinanceManager #CorporateFinance #FPandA #Fundraising #FinancialPlanning #BudgetManagement #FinanceCareers #HoChiMinhCity #VietnamJobs
